SELECT product_code, product_name, spec, material_cost, labor_cost, packaging_cost, logistics_cost, margin, total_price, current_price, client_name FROM pricing
WHERE product_name ILIKE '%' || #{_parameter} || '%' OR product_code ILIKE '%' || #{_parameter} || '%' OR client_name ILIKE '%' || #{_parameter} || '%'
ORDER BY product_code

SELECT product_code, product_name, spec, product_type, material_cost, markup_rate, markup_cost, loss_rate, loss_cost, labor_cost, packaging_cost, logistics_cost, margin, other_cost1, other_cost1_note, other_cost2, other_cost2_note, other_cost3, other_cost3_note, other_cost4, other_cost4_note, current_price, total_price, client_name FROM pricing WHERE product_code = #{productCode}

SELECT material_name AS "materialName", ratio_percent AS "ratioPercent", unit_price_per_kg AS "unitPricePerKg", amount_per_kg AS "amountPerKg" FROM bom WHERE product_code = #{productCode} ORDER BY rank_in_product
mapper.update: UPDATE pricing SET total_price = COALESCE(material_cost, 0) + COALESCE(loss_cost, 0) + COALESCE(markup_cost, 0) + COALESCE(labor_cost, 0) + COALESCE(packaging_cost, 0) + COALESCE(logistics_cost, 0) + COALESCE(margin, 0) + COALESCE(other_cost1, 0) + COALESCE(other_cost2, 0) + COALESCE(other_cost3, 0) + COALESCE(other_cost4, 0) WHERE product_code = #{productCode}
